en.headline: HKPC launches AI for All programme with free training for SMEs
en.dek: The Productivity Council opened the final segment of the government’s HK$50 million inclusive AI initiative on Thursday, focusing on practical skills for small firms.
body: The Hong Kong Productivity Council on Thursday launched the AI for All Inclusive Programme, offering free training and practical support to help small and medium-sized enterprises and workers adopt artificial intelligence.

Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry Sun Dong said more than 90 per cent of Hong Kong businesses are SMEs and that helping them upgrade through AI is a key direction of the initiative. The council is collaborating with technology firms including Google and Microsoft on courses covering content creation, data analysis and workflow efficiency.

The programme forms part of a broader government effort that aims to deliver more than 200 activities and reach 50,000 people within two years. Courses target sectors such as education, healthcare, manufacturing, retail and logistics.

zh.headline: 生產力局啟動全民AI普惠計劃 為中小企提供免費培訓
zh.dek: 香港生產力促進局周四啟動政府5,000萬港元「全民AI」普惠計劃的企業賦能部分，聚焦中小企實務應用培訓。
body: 香港生產力促進局周四舉行「全民AI」普惠計劃啟動禮，推出以企業實務為核心的培訓及支援，協助中小企及在職人士掌握人工智能應用。
創新科技及工業局局長孫東表示，香港超過九成企業為中小企，協助它們透過AI實現數碼轉型、提升競爭力是計劃重點方向。生產力局與Google、微軟等科技企業合作，提供涵蓋文案創作、數據分析及工作流程優化等免費課程。
該計劃屬政府整體「全民AI」工作一部分，目標兩年內舉辦逾200項活動、惠及5萬人次，課程涵蓋教育、醫療、製造、零售及物流等行業。
